header: Start with one till and your own article list
lead: The trial is the whole programme, not a cut-down version of it. Whoever stays after thirty days does not have to set anything up a second time.
note: The account is created on the next page. After thirty days a till costs € 39 a month.

reassurances.title: No card
reassurances.text: The trial ends by itself. There is nothing to cancel and nothing that quietly turns into a subscription.

reassurances.title: Twenty minutes to set up
reassurances.text: Import the article list, connect the printer, sell. It only takes longer where scales are involved.

reassurances.title: Your figures stay yours
reassurances.text: If you stop, you export everything as CSV and we delete the rest without having to be asked.
